caption: Rain streams down a window, and the trees outside seen through the wet glass wobble and blur where the water runs.

sa.check: Trees outside are seen through the wet glass.
The view wobbles and blurs where the water runs.
The distortion moves downward with the drops.

pc.expect: The view is distorted only along the running water and clear elsewhere.
pc.fail: The whole pane is blurred with only a few tracks; or the tracks leave the view sharp; or the blur is where no water runs.

pc.expect: The trees themselves are unchanged; only their image wobbles along the tracks.
pc.fail: The trees bend; or a different scene appears in a track; or the trees change shape between tracks.

pc.expect: The water runs downward and the distortion moves with it.
pc.fail: Water runs up the glass; or the tracks are still while blur moves; or drops hang without moving.

pc.expect: The water is liquid running in tracks and the glass is rigid.
pc.fail: The water is rigid; or the glass ripples; or the drops bounce.

pc.expect: One window and the trees outside.
pc.fail: A tree vanishes; or a second window appears; or the water becomes solid.

pc.expect: The frame and the trees' colours stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes; or the trees change colour; or the room changes.
